notes.title: A-Escape VR - Permanent Price Drop to $4.99!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/937e40586c7890b4e35016e80ddaa24f84116aac.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

Well, it's been over a year since A-Escape VR released on Steam. Since the game's release, it's received multiple updates, tweaks, and even a complete texture overhaul. All of you have been busy, too! You've made plenty of gameplay videos for the game, and even helped each other overcome the more difficult puzzles. I couldn't ask for a better community of players, you've all been great!

So, as a thank you to the community (and just in time for Halloween, too!), we're lowering the price permanently from $9.99 to $4.99, effective immediately. Now you can enjoy an escape room experience designed by a real-life escape room business for less than a quarter of what it would cost to go in real life!

One more thing. I would just like to take a moment extend a sincere thank you on behalf of everyone at A-Escape and myself. It's been a long road: From pre-production, to the very first demo release, to the full game's release and beyond, you've all been there with us every step of the way. Thank you!

Anyway, we hope you all enjoy the game at its new price. Thank you so much for playing the game!

Cheers,
- Thomas

notes.title: A-Escape VR - Update for February 6th, 2018
notes.content:
Hello again,

I've recently been informed that the current build of A-Escape VR was no longer working for Vive users, while Oculus users were unaffected. This was due to an old version of VRTK and an incompatibility with what I can only assume was an update to SteamVR.

This patch for the main game and demo addresses those issues, among other things.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Updated the game to Unity 5.5.4p3
    [*]Patched a vulnerability caused by building the game from an older version of Unity
    [*]Fixed an issue where the grip buttons for Vive users were not working
    [*]Fixed an issue in the demo where the right-hand controller for Vive users in the hub room did not activate the teleport beam
    [*]Submitted prices for the new currencies on Steam
[/list]

Thank you for playing A-Escape VR. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused; if you have any other issues, please contact me directly using the form on my website:

http://www.theneptune.site

I receive emails from the contact form instantly, which will notify me immediately to address any further issues.

Thanks again,
- Thomas

Best regards,
- Thomas

notes.title: Oculus Support now in Beta!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/937e40586c7890b4e35016e80ddaa24f84116aac.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Thanks to the recent Oculus sale, I was able to pick up an Oculus Rift for A-Escape VR. After a couple days of re-mapping buttons for the Touch controllers, re-drawing and re-recording the tutorial, and adding seated/front-facing support, the Oculus-ready build of A-Escape VR is now in the beta stage for anyone who owns the game that is interested in playing with the Oculus Rift.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/d766e0f220e7c3d46f3fc34b0af2d607668a62d6.png[/img]

Support for Touch is not completely ready for the main branch though, as I haven't had the opportunity to play test the game as vigorously as the Vive build. Oculus support will stay in Beta for one week; if there are no issues after that, then I'll move the Oculus build into the full release. I'll be sure to post an announcement when Oculus support goes live in the full release as well.

To access the oculus build of A-Escape VR, right click on A-Escape VR in Steam, then Properties, then go to the Betas tab and use the password "oculustesting" (without quotes) to enable the Oculus Beta branch, where you can start downloading the Oculus build. Once it's completed, browse the local files (by going into the Properties window again, then the Local Files tab, then Browse Local Files) and start A-Escape VR - Chapter 1 (Oculus).exe. Make sure you enable running third-party sources in the Oculus application before running.

And that's it! You can then start playing the game with the Oculus Rift and Touch controllers. Keep in mind that Oculus Touch is required; there is no gamepad support.

If you experience any issues with the Oculus build of A-Escape VR, please leave a post in the forums and I'll do my best to address them. Have fun!

Until next time,
- Thomas

notes.title: Patch for July 15th
notes.content:
First off, I need to apologize. This patch addresses an oversight I had when fixing the magnifying glass in Chapter 1, where upon starting the room your view would be attached to the magnifying glass. What was supposed to be a routine camera adjustment ended up completely breaking the majority of the game, and I can't apologize enough for those who picked up A-Escape VR with the hopes of playing through Chapter 1 and ended up experiencing this problem.

The issue is now fixed, and you should be able to play through Chapter 1 as usual. Due to some technical difficulty behind the scenes the update was not available to clients until earlier today.

Thank you so much for your patience.
- Thomas

notes.title: A-Escape VR is 50% during the Summer Sale, the new update is live, and Trading Cards are now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/937e40586c7890b4e35016e80ddaa24f84116aac.jpg[/img]

Hello again!

First off, Happy Summer Sale! A-Escape VR is 50% off during the summer sale. If you've been thinking about picking up A-Escape VR for yourself or a friend, now is a great time to do so!

Today we're pushing out the newest update to A-Escape VR which adds new textures for the game. These textures have been recreated from scratch from their original size to high resolution 4k textures. Both the full game and the demo will be updated with the new textures found in Episode 0: Julia. The hope is to bring Episode 0: Julia to the same visual fidelity as Episode 1, so this update will hopefully be a step in the right direction towards that goal. The game should automatically adjust the textures according to the quality settings, so if you experience performance issues after the update you can adjust the quality by holding down the control key when launching the game.

That's not all though, trading cards are now available! Now you can collect trading cards, craft badges, and get some fancy emotes and profile backgrounds!

We hope you all will enjoy this new update along with the trading cards. If you experience any issues, please feel free to use the community discussions to report bugs and we'll address them as soon as we can.

Until next time,
- Thomas

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Recreated the floor, wall, ceiling, and table textures in Chapter 0 into 4k textures with improved bump+normal maps (applies to demo and full game)
    [*]Added a button to skip the intro for Chapter 1
    [*]Added trading cards
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Commercial licenses now available, and a look at the road ahead:
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/937e40586c7890b4e35016e80ddaa24f84116aac.jpg[/img]

Hello again!

First things first: Commercial licenses for A-Escape VR are now available! The license is only visible to licensees and can now be purchased on the game’s store page - directly under the regular end user price.

If you run a VR arcade and wanted to show A-Escape VR at your location, be sure to check it out!

Here's what we have planned in the future for A-Escape VR:

First, texture work. I'm currently in the process of remaking as many of the textures as I can into high-quality 4k textures. You can see the progress below:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/89fa59e707eb8e00fa3061786d54a79647888124.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/44b5639ddb220af8a8b028191059916b0703f8c7.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/139b674e7e694cf86c420e5521dbcc268e68c79a.png[/img]

As you can see, it's all very crisp and looks much better than it did before (especially in VR!). Many users expressed their dissatisfaction with the low-resolution textures, so I'm dedicating my effort to improve this aspect for you all.

There are a lot of textures to sort through and remake, but you can expect this update to arrive sometime in early June. The texture update will also include an option to skip the intro section of Chapter 1 for those wanting to go straight into the room.

I'll also be writing up an official guide for Chapter 1 as well over the next couple of days. You all have worked together to arrive to solutions for this chapter in the forums, which is incredible! The official guide will be made available so you can all get past that one part you needed help with, whichever part it may be.

Trading cards are also in the works, which we'd also like to have finished for the texture update. We'll let you know when they're ready so you can start collecting them!

We thank you sincerely for your patience as we continue to improve this experience for you all. Enjoy your summer!

Until next time,
- Thomas

notes.title: Update for April 1st
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Changed how objects behave when being held while teleporting
[/list]

It's a small update today. This should keep objects from getting caught on things they shouldn't get caught on, which often resulted in the object flying off. I can't promise this will 100% fix the issue some users are having with objects disappearing, because neither me nor any of my play testers have encountered this specific bug and can't run test cases to try and find the cause of it.

That being said, [i][b]if a prop disappears, press the menu button and press the reset props button.[/b][/i] It's a simple fix you can do yourself without having to restart the entire room and will retain your current progress.

If you encounter any bugs, we strongly recommend you post a bug report in the community discussions so we can keep track of them and post updates on them accordingly.

Thank you.
- Thomas

Nothing much else to say here, just a sincere thank you to everyone! Your feedback and encouragement have helped us make the game we wanted to make, and make the game you all wanted to play. We hope you all enjoy the game, and we can't wait to see you all play it.

Best regards,
- Thomas

notes.title: A-Escape VR will be available on March 31st!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/937e40586c7890b4e35016e80ddaa24f84116aac.jpg[/img]

Hello again!

So as you can guess from the title, we have a release date! We will be releasing A-Escape VR on March 31st, 2017. The game will be available for $9.99 and will feature two chapters: Chapter 0: Julia and Chapter 1: A House in the Woods.

Each chapter is a self-contained story, and they both have their own unique puzzles for you to solve.

Chapter 0 is the same as the demo you can download right now. It is designed to be completed in about 30 minutes and follows your story as a kidnapped victim left alone in a psychopath's abandoned shack. As you go through the room you will find out about the previous victim as you escape.

Chapter 1 is a brand new escape room from A-Escape offering an escape room experience designed to be completed in one hour. While on a camping trip, you follow a mysterious light towards a house sitting in the middle of the woods. As the door locks behind you, you discover that you may not be the only one in there. In this room, you have one hour to escape. If you exit in time, you will avoid the terror lying in wait. After one hour though, if you try to escape you'll be greeted by a... special guest. Stay sharp, stay focused, and maybe you'll survive.

We'd like to extend a very sincere thank you to each and every player that took the time to play the A-Escape VR demo over the past few months. We hope you all are as excited to play the new room as we are to release this for you all to enjoy.

See you on March 31st!

Until next time,
- Thomas

notes.title: Updated Demo and Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/937e40586c7890b4e35016e80ddaa24f84116aac.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today we've uploaded a new build of the A-Escape VR demo for you all to enjoy. This demo, as before, is free and includes one room that is designed to be completed in 30 minutes. It also has a tutorial room to allow users to practice interacting with the locks in a stress-free environment.

The included episode in the demo, Episode 0: Julia, is still the same, but there is now a new tutorial room for users to get acquainted with the controls.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/1607d7fd100527c47acec370d04e0b4e90727615.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/79a55c65984276de04b931e513bac1b426b7db3e.png[/img]

This tutorial has been frequently requested, and as we approach the release date of the full release of A-Escape VR, we hope this update will encourage those who were confused with the control scheme before to go back and try it again with help from the tutorial.

You can find a changelog for the updated demo at the end of this announcement. Enjoy!

Speaking of release dates, [b]we're now pushing the release date up from December 2017![/b] We are now releasing A-Escape VR in the upcoming weeks instead, slating the release for [b]late March or early April.[/b]

The new room is the first full-length escape room for A-Escape VR, titled "Episode 1: A House in the Woods."

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/bda604a114d6b3aba6267466c7a967c7e1cb3874.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474784/54280287f1879e1c342bf00b7d755e59b0ac6103.png[/img]

A new gameplay teaser has been uploaded on the store page, showing the setting for the new room and giving you all a glimpse into the first full-length A-Escape VR experience.

We're very excited to release this new chapter for you all to enjoy, and we hope you're all just as excited as we are! Once we decide on a final release date, we will post another announcement to let you all know!

Be sure to follow us on social media for up-to-date information on A-Escape and A-Escape VR!

A-Escape Official Facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/ashevilleescape

A-Escape Official Twitter:
https://twitter.com/aescapeavl

Our website:
http://www.a-escape.com

And if you're in the Asheville, NC area, feel free to stop by the physical A-Escape location!
353 New Leicester Hwy
Asheville, NC, 28806
Office Suite F

Until next time,
- Thomas

[h1]Changelog for March 17th 2017[/h1]

[b]Demo[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaced splash screen with the official A-Escape Logo
[*]Added a new tutorial room, with diagrams and voiceovers explaining the controls of each lock found in the game. Insert a tape into one of the tape decks to hear the explanations.
[*]Added a combination lock which appears in the tutorial but does not appear in Chapter 0.
[*]Changed the volume of the crowbar so it matches the volume of other props
[*]Added guides on the track pad for slide locks and number locks. These will appear when interacting with a lock to help guide your thumb in the right position when trying to interact with a lock.
[*]Added a floor height adjustment option in the menu. You can now lower or raise your playspace to make reaching objects on the ground easier. Playspace adjustments will stay consistent between teleports until you load a new room.
[*]Added a slide lock in the menu. This is handy for long slide lock combinations, as it allows you to keep track of a combination and use it when you need it without having to go back and forth between clues.
[/list]
